brief:
Settlers stormed a Palestinian council building in the village of Beita, located south of Nablus in the occupied West Bank, Shehab Wire reported. The incursion occurred at a municipal facility serving the village administration.

The raid represents the latest in an ongoing pattern of settler intrusions into Palestinian-controlled communities across the West Bank. Such incidents have become frequent flashpoints of tension between Palestinian residents and Israeli settlers operating in the territory. The circumstances surrounding the storming, including any demands made by the settlers or response from Palestinian authorities, remained unclear from initial reports.
